_comment: Who gets each form. Edit this file, run `npx wrangler deploy` from the
worker folder, and the change is live. No code change needed.
A form with no entry here falls back to _default.
Addresses ending in @ukccatholic.org are accepted as-is. Anything else has
to also be listed in EXTRA_ALLOWED_RECIPIENTS in wrangler.toml, so that
someone who gets hold of this repo cannot quietly redirect parish mail.
Nine recipients per form is the ceiling.
